prompt:
Create a high fidelity OmniGear 'Desempenho' UI design comparison. Use the provided approved DPI screen as strict VISUAL IDENTITY reference only: same header, sidebar, font, spacing grammar, neutral monochrome materials, thin borders and footer. Replace DPI content with polling-rate/performance controls. Square board with TWO complete equal desktop landscape screens stacked vertically: dark above, light below. Identical content/layout across themes. No external captions or browser chrome. Crisp, comfortably readable Brazilian Portuguese.
Header 'OmniGear' and 'Demonstração' badge; ONLY ONE crescent moon outline icon at upper-right in dark, ONLY ONE sun outline icon in light. No theme switch, no paired icons. Left sidebar 20% width: '← Dispositivos', 'Mouse de demonstração', 'Perfil 1' dropdown, then 'Botões', 'DPI', 'Desempenho' selected, 'Parâmetros', 'Perfis', 'Geral'. Main heading 'Desempenho', subtitle 'Ajuste a frequência de resposta do mouse.'
Main scope is ONLY 'Taxa de reporte' and an explanatory autonomy estimate. No sensor presets, no new performance modes, no invented brand logos, no graphs or benchmark scores. Rate values 125, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000 Hz. Current selected 1000 Hz, clearly indicated textually and with contrasting neutral selection. Helper: 'Define quantas vezes por segundo o mouse envia dados ao computador.' Supporting readout 'Intervalo entre envios' / '1 ms'. Do not label this end-to-end latency.
Autonomy information: heading 'Autonomia estimada', value '45–56 h', short text 'Com bateria cheia e taxa de 1000 Hz.', small clearly readable 'Exemplo simulado' badge so this is explicitly illustrative demo data. One short note 'Taxas maiores podem aumentar o consumo de energia.' No battery percentage, actual battery telemetry or promises. Estimation information is secondary to controls, moderate type size, not giant hero metric.
Main footer at bottom, unchanged reference: '1 alteração não salva' at left; 'Descartar' secondary and 'Salvar no perfil' primary right. White primary on dark, black primary on light. Preserve all these controls and scopes across themes.
COMPOSITION 3: Product-led workspace reflecting user's mouse configuration reference. Large realistic matte-black five-button mouse top view centered in left two-thirds of main body; entire body visible, NO numbered button hotspots or leader lines because this is performance. Right third narrow quiet information stack: 'Intervalo entre envios'1ms, thin divider, 'Autonomia estimada'45–56h with simulation badge and battery-full explanation. Directly BELOW mouse/information area full-width 'Taxa de reporte' heading and short explanation with seven-option segmented row125/250/500/1000/2000/4000/8000 Hz,1000 selected. Short energy note below. Product about230px tall per desktop viewport; allow all controls and standard footer to fit. No flashy glowing imagery, background decorations or cards around the mouse.
title: Mouse em destaque
description: Prévia do mouse com taxa de reporte na base e autonomia ao lado.
notes: Autonomy is illustrative and explicitly labeled simulated. Supported polling rates and autonomy availability depend on actual device capabilities. Interval is 1000/rate ms, not full system latency.
